fit_selection: WT2 train articles in source order; first 2048-token prefix of each eligible article, one window per article; skip exact validation article/title duplicates or any shared 64-token segment with fixed eval windows; first 8 eligible articles
ALS_initialization: canonical marginal only; no selection among initializations
ALS_stop: both criteria in two consecutive complete cycles, else report maximum-iteration stop without optimality claim
threshold_reason: Prospective practical criterion: 2 percentage points of uncompensated damage for correction, 2 percentage points of recovery prediction MAE; chosen before fitting/evaluation, distinct from Exp-2 structural-error budgets.
statistics_precision: FP64 S, full-channel A and G, contractions, ALS, roots and dense gesvd; frozen teacher FP32/eager
cache: atomic per-sample FP64 S and gradient Gram on disk; FP32 window x once; stream each S for ALS; retain cache
pilot: first fitting window, first 2 labels, both modules; shared-weight autograd and both contraction paths; 1 complete ALS cycle and dense rank-64 SVD per module; no eval effects read
formal_gate: freeze manifest after reviewing pilot correctness and extrapolated cost; no automatic budget increase or effect-based changes
